finalText:
**Redis died at 02:14:07, and the service bled out over 18 minutes.**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:10 | Cache bypassed. Store timeouts start. |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth 502 passes max 500 |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` OOM, then `api` killed. Service down. |

Redis never came back. All 13 reconnect tries got `ECONNREFUSED`, the last at [app.log:716](logs/app.log:716).

Cause is Redis, not your code. 173 timeouts and 174 cache-miss lines are all downstream noise.

Next: check why Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections.
